name: Kuban People's Republic (1918–1920)
description: Three horizontal stripes of blue, raspberry-pink and green, the central stripe twice the width of the others.
history: Adopted by the Kuban Rada on 10 February 1919 for the Cossack republic that had declared independence at Yekaterinodar on 28 January 1918. The republic fell to the Red Army in March 1920; the flag was revived by Krasnodar Krai in 1995.

features.symbolism: blue for the Don and Black Sea Cossacks, raspberry for the Zaporozhian Cossack heritage, green for the mountain peoples
